data.narrative:
Akash Systems is a Series B-stage space & aerospace company that has raised $40M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, and Skyryse, spanning Series B through Series C stages.

Two valuation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method, anchoring to $40M in total raised and applying a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implies a $76M valuation. The peer-median method across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies yields a median valuation of $1.5B, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. The public-comp anchoring approach—using a 26.4x price-to-sales median across the public set—is not applicable due to absence of disclosed revenue data for the target.

The triangulated analysis across both applicable methods suggests a valuation range of $65M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $788M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-specific positioning: the stage-progression method yields conservative results based on capital raised, while peer-median valuation—anchored to later-stage, likely more mature peers—implies substantially higher value. Key unknowns include Akash's revenue traction relative to the peer set and trajectory expectations within the Series B window.
